Byron, saw MirrorWeb launched Trusted Contacts for mobile archiving and partnered with Smartria on compliance.

Shipping new product and partnerships usually means more in-market regulated-industry accounts than your team can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for MirrorWeb off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Byron, quick follow-up for MirrorWeb.

As the product expands, pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings MirrorWeb needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Byron, last bit of proof for MirrorWeb.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how MirrorWeb's reply rate likely compares to other compliance and archiving software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
